dateDisplay: Historical panel period: 1900–1929; photograph taken: 16 October 2026
context: The 1900–1929 heading is the period represented by the retrospective panel. Duane Wilkins photographed it on 16 October 2026; that is the capture date, not the date of the historical events or archival photographs shown in the panel. The panel describes a provisional New Zealand Geographic Board appointment in 1924; this remains distinct from the Board’s later statutory establishment. The original JPEG is preserved unchanged; the full-size display and card variants apply EXIF orientation 6 without cropping.
derivativesNote: The supplied original JPEG bytes are retained unchanged under the source filename. Its EXIF Orientation 6 is applied to the full-resolution WebP and the card WebP; both keep the complete panel in frame without cropping. The original can be downloaded from this page.
